summary: Verified the experiments reader's ten findings: eight kept (one confirmed as given, seven modified) and two dropped. The one confirmed as given is the purpose line for experiments/README.md. The seven modified: (2) UE32's comparison with 08's verdict that what survives of the account is no discovery. The lead now says less, line 73 is deleted, and theories/becoming/results/data/lineage.json (nov-ue32: what.en, what.zh, evidence quote and locator) must change in the same commit. Its evidence quotes 'This one does not change it', and lineage.py line 192 reports an error when a quote is no longer in its file. (3, 4) The Lean front in English and Chinese: kind changed to purpose, and note 13's bound on premises added. (5) The label for the 5-8 October folders: the dates are corrected, since 9 October is when the theory was named and its Lean spine begun, and LINEAGE is linked. (6) agentdojo: the restated current frame is dropped, since the label already says it once, and the same pattern at line 5 is added. (7) market-generativity: kind changed to ai-over-aim. (8) recipient-harm-valuation: the line-3 instance also drops 'canonical' on a history file. Dropped: recipient-cue-grounding (true limits said where they belong, and a change of construct) and recipient-value-learning (a list of open questions, consistent with 07 §1's four questions; Ren's message 7 is about the standing of claims). Every quote was checked as an exact, single substring at its line. Every link target and anchor was checked. tests.json, the atlas, source-index and lineage.json were searched for citations of the edited lines, and only lineage.json's UE32 entry is affected. No receipt hashes these READMEs, and the history checkers that read them are not run by the gate. Pointers outside this file group: MAP.md line 66 describes experiments/ as 'Executable research' (MAP's own area); study §508 and 08 §8 keep the novelty verdict on UE32 (other areas; §508 is a study note, to be listed, not edited); generative-basis/README.md calls a history copy 'the canonical chapter'. No make, render, gate, test, lake or build was run.
